title: 布倫納基線隧道~Brenner Base Tunnel
focus: 先進坑、長距離多工作面與跨境基準~Exploratory gallery, multiple long drives and cross-border datums
summary: 布倫納官方區分55公里基線隧道與包含既有繞行連接的64公里地下路線，並說明下方先進坑的地質調查和未來維護用途。本課由這個三孔系統出發，分析探查更新、多工作面物流、岩體水壓、控制網與軌道需求；各標段里程碑不被誤寫為全工程完工。~BBT distinguishes the 55 km base tunnel from a 64 km linked underground route including the existing bypass and describes the lower exploratory gallery. This course follows that three-tunnel system through geological updates, multi-heading logistics, rock and water response, survey control and railway needs. Lot milestones are not presented as whole-project completion.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 布倫納55公里主體與64公里連接路線有不同端點，教材先分開工程數量、列車行程與支坑總長。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~The 55 km main works and 64 km linked route have different endpoints; separate quantities, train travel and total gallery length. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=18 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=18 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為19.8 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=18 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 19.8 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對每種長度是否沿同一路徑及包含既有段。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check whether each length follows the same route and includes existing sections. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把64公里當新建主孔長度會重複計入既有連接。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Using 64 km as new main-bore length double-counts existing connections. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對每種長度是否沿同一路徑及包含既有段。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check whether each length follows the same route and includes existing sections. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 下方先進坑提供布倫納主孔前方資訊，但高程差使構造外推需保留不確定性。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~The lower exploratory gallery informs main-bore forecasts, but elevation separation leaves uncertainty in projecting structures upward. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=350 m²。Q=k i A=0.000735 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0008085 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=350 m². Q=k i A=0.000735 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0008085 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以裂隙方位投影到主孔，再用超前孔覆核。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Project fractures to main-bore level and check with advance probes. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 先進坑乾燥不證明上方主孔不會遇另一連通水帶。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~A dry exploratory gallery does not exclude another connected water zone above. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以裂隙方位投影到主孔，再用超前孔覆核。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Project fractures to main-bore level and check with advance probes. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 三孔系統的排水互相影響，布倫納教材研究先進坑降水如何改變主孔施工與永久水頭。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Drainage interacts across three galleries; examine how exploratory-gallery relief changes main-bore construction and permanent heads. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=92 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=902.52 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為992.772 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=92 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=902.52 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 992.772 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步比較三孔壓力、流量與補注事件。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare pressure, flow and recharge events across all three galleries. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把三孔出流相加而未查連通可能重複估計獨立補注。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Summing flows without connectivity checks can double-count supposedly independent recharge. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：同步比較三孔壓力、流量與補注事件。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare pressure, flow and recharge events across all three galleries. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 長基線隧道穿越不同覆土和構造，教材把彈性洞壁應力與節理控制破壞分開選模。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~A long base tunnel crosses varying cover and structure; distinguish elastic wall stress from joint-controlled failure when selecting models. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=950 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為81.51 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=950 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 81.51 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 單用覆土排序危險程度會漏掉低覆土弱帶的變形。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Ranking hazard by cover alone misses deformation in weak shallow zones. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 多標段支護設計需要一致證據格式但不必相同參數，布倫納教材研究地質分區與封閉時序。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Different lots need consistent evidence formats without identical parameters; examine ground domains and closure timing. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=45 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=405 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為445.5 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=45 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=405 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 445.5 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將相同開挖齡期的荷重及收斂放在同地質組比較。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare loads and convergence at equal excavation age within one ground domain. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 跨地質平均參數會把真正局部擠壓訊號稀釋。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Averaging across geology dilutes genuine local squeezing signals. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將相同開挖齡期的荷重及收斂放在同地質組比較。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Compare loads and convergence at equal excavation age within one ground domain. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 布倫納多機多工作面背景適合比較利用率，教材按岩性和停時原因校正後才比較日進尺。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Multiple machines and headings require comparisons normalised by ground and downtime cause before daily advance is ranked. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.95 m/h；有效利用率=0.325 無因次。D=24vu=15.21 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.731 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.95 m/h; utilisation=0.325 dimensionless. D=24vu=15.21 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.731 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以完整班次重建切削、拼裝、保養和運輸時間帳。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：以完整班次重建切削、拼裝、保養和運輸時間帳。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為212.121 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 212.121 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.069115 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.069115 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 低坡度是布倫納運輸目的之一，教材計算坡度功率後另外列出加速、氣動與列車間距需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~Low gradient supports the transport purpose; calculate grade power while separately listing acceleration, aerodynamics and spacing demands. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.5e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1942.38 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2136.62 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.5e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1942.38 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2136.62 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對坡度無因次換算及列車質量，再比同速方案。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check dimensionless grade conversion and mass before equal-speed comparison. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把千分比當百分比會使坡度功率放大十倍。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Confusing per mille with percent multiplies grade power by ten. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對坡度無因次換算及列車質量，再比同速方案。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check dimensionless grade conversion and mass before equal-speed comparison. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 先進坑由調查轉為維護用途時，資料需保留地質與設備兩種索引，避免施工資料在營運期失聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~As the exploratory gallery gains a maintenance role, preserve both geological and equipment indexing through handover. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=115 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.6957 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=115 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.6957 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Brenner Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「掘進利用率與設備停時」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=350 m²。Q=k i A=0.000735 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0008085 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：切削速率=1.95 m/h；有效利用率=0.325 無因次。D=24vu=15.21 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.731 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate boring utilisation and equipment downtime. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=350 m². Q=k i A=0.000735 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0008085 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.95 m/h; utilisation=0.325 dimensionless. D=24vu=15.21 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.731 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2014 年公開記錄：Tulfes–Pfons施工標開始施工；不是全工程通車日期。布倫納官方區分55公里基線隧道與包含既有繞行連接的64公里地下路線，並說明下方先進坑的地質調查和未來維護用途。本課由這個三孔系統出發，分析探查更新、多工作面物流、岩體水壓、控制網與軌道需求；各標段里程碑不被誤寫為全工程完工。本課把「先進坑、長距離多工作面與跨境基準」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2014: Work starts on the Tulfes–Pfons lot; this is not whole-project opening. BBT distinguishes the 55 km base tunnel from a 64 km linked underground route including the existing bypass and describes the lower exploratory gallery. This course follows that three-tunnel system through geological updates, multi-heading logistics, rock and water response, survey control and railway needs. Lot milestones are not presented as whole-project completion. The course treats exploratory gallery, multiple long drives and cross-border datums as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 55 km base tunnel; 64 km linked route，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 55 km base tunnel; 64 km linked route; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2014 年事件：Tulfes–Pfons施工標開始施工；不是全工程通車日期。~2014 event: Work starts on the Tulfes–Pfons lot; this is not whole-project opening.
教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=18 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=18 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=18 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 18 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.000735 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=1e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.000735 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「支護安裝時點」：局部剛度=45 kN/mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=405 kN；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching support activation time: local stiffness=45 kN/mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 405 kN; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「有效掘進利用率」：切削速率=1.95 m/h，其餘輸入依單元，結果=15.21 m/day；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching effective boring utilisation: active penetration=1.95 m/h, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 15.21 m/day; not measured or accepted project data.
